verdict.rationale: Alloy's own materials mention perpetual KYC/KYB and AML checks, which cover individuals and companies, and refer to watchlists being updated as an asynchronous event. No source explicitly documents sanctions screening or choosing which lists to screen against, so support is only glancing. Missing for 10: explicit sanctions/watchlist screening documentation, selection of specific sanctions lists or watchlists, list coverage details, match/hit handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can screen individuals and companies against selected sanctions and watchlists

citations.quote: Streamline perpetual KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks with fully auditable agentic automation
